description: A dispute arose between Trump administration officials and an OpenAI executive. Dean W. Ball suggested spreading FUD regarding Chinese AI models. Pentagon official Emil Michael criticized Ball's strategy as "village idiot" thinking. Michael stated restrictions were legally enacted for national security. The exchange highlights differing views on AI regulation and national security.
title: Pentagon is angry with top exec of Altman's OpenAI, calls him 'supreme village idiot'

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Spain secured their World Cup title with a late extra-time goal from Ferran Torres.  This victory mirrored Andres Iniesta's decisive strike from sixteen years prior.  Argentina's performance lacked intensity and suffered from disciplinary issues throughout the match.  Spain's methodical and dynamic play contrasted sharply with Argentina's struggles.  The event concluded with a poignant moment between Lionel Messi and Lamine Yamal.
title: Method over madness: How Spain's collective brilliance conquered the world

title: Sikkim tunnel landslide: Seven dead, several feared trapped as rescue operation continues

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: FIFA has launched an investigation into post-match clashes following Argentina's World Cup final loss. Several Argentina players were involved in confrontations with Spanish counterparts after the game. FIFA's Disciplinary Committee has appointed a prosecutor to examine these potential breaches. Players found guilty of violent conduct face a minimum three-match suspension. The Argentine Football Association could also face disciplinary action and fines.
title: Argentina players could face FIFA bans - here's why

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Spain defeated Argentina in the FIFA World Cup 2026 final after extra time. Lionel Messi shared an emotional message acknowledging the immense pain of the loss. He expressed pride in the team's achievement of reaching consecutive World Cup finals. Substitute Ferran Torres scored the decisive goal in the 106th minute of the match. The defeat ended Argentina's hopes of defending their title successfully.
title: 'The pain is immense': Lionel Messi pens emotional note after Argentina lose World Cup final

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: The peril faced by Carnaby's black cockatoos is escalating, as pesticide contamination in their food reaches alarming rates. Testing of seed samples revealed that toxic chemicals present are hundreds of times higher than what is legally permissible. This exposure might shed light on the troubling paralysis syndrome afflicting these endangered birds. Furthermore, researchers identified neurotoxic substances banned in various regions of Europe.
title: Pesticides found in 80% seed samples eaten by endangered Australian cockatoos

author: SURENDRA SINGH
description: India's defence ministry seeks domestic firms for airship-based pseudo satellites.  These platforms will provide persistent intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance capabilities.  The program aims to offer lower-cost alternatives to existing satellite systems.  Airships will hover in the stratosphere, bridging gaps between drones and satellites.  The Indian Air Force is actively partnering with local aerospace companies for this initiative.
title: Defence ministry seeks firms for Rs 15,000 cr high-altitude airship project

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Ryan Clark's decade-long run at ESPN ended abruptly after the network reportedly informed him of its decision during an episode of NFL Live. His exit comes as Disney implements widespread layoffs across ESPN and NFL Network. Reports suggest internal concerns over past on-air incidents and workplace tensions contributed to the decision. Despite the surprising departure, Clark's successful broadcasting career and popular podcast are expected to create new opportunities.
title: Ryan Clark was reportedly fired by ESPN amid Disney layoffs and internal tensions

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey crossed eighty crore rupees at the Indian box office. The epic fantasy adventure saw collections drop significantly on its first Monday. Still, the film continued its dominance, earning over eight crore rupees on day four. The English version remains the biggest contributor to its overall success. The Odyssey delivered Christopher Nolan's biggest opening day in India.
title: 'The Odyssey' BO collection: Nolan's epic starring Matt Damon crosses Rs 80 crore mark in India

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Controversial influencer Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan Tate appeared in a federal courtroom in Miami on Monday as extradition proceedings to the United Kingdom formally began over a fresh set of criminal charges, including rape and sex trafficking. Their attorney, Joe McBride, later told reporters that the brothers would contest the extradition request.
title: Tate brothers to fight UK extradition after US court appearance on rape, trafficking charges

author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
description: The Supreme Court has taken over the Ayodhya Ram Mandir fund embezzlement investigation. Local police have been removed from the probe, which will now be led by a senior IPS officer. The Shri Ram Teerth Kshetra Trust must preserve all donation receipts and accounts for scrutiny. The court cautioned against politicizing the ongoing investigation into alleged fund pilferage. Eight individuals have already been arrested as the probe progresses impartially.
title: Supreme Court orders new SIT into Ram temple donation theft, will monitor probe

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: United States forces conducted tenth night of strikes against Iran.  These operations aim to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after recent attacks.  Iran also targeted US allies Kuwait, Jordan, and Bahrain with missile barrages.  Diplomatic efforts continue while the interim ceasefire agreement has collapsed.  Global energy supplies face fresh concerns as oil prices climb.
title: 'They will pay many times over': Trump as US carries out 10th night of Iran strikes

author: TNN
description: A protest by the Cockroach Janta Party demanding a minister's resignation turned chaotic. Protesters clashed with police, resulting in numerous injuries on both sides. Police reported detentions and filed charges related to rioting and assault on public servants. The BJP blamed Left-affiliated student groups for instigating the organized violence. Investigations are underway to establish criminal responsibility for the disturbances.
title: 118 cops & 60 marchers injured: Cops block protesters' march to Parl; Nadda meets CJP leaders
